definitions.explanation: A fastener made of two strips, one with tiny hooks and one with loops, that stick together when pressed. マジックテープ is a trademark of the Japanese company Kuraray, used for any such fastener.

examples.japanese: マジックテープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧マジックテープだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぎ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧やすい。
examples.english: These shoes have Velcro straps, so they're easy to take off.

examples.japanese: マジックテープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はがす⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The sound of Velcro being pulled apart echoed through the quiet meeting room.
